title: Differentiation
overview: A focused revision guide to differentiation.

sections.title: Core rules
content: Standard derivatives:  Chain, product and quotient rules extend this to combinations of functions (developed further in P2/P3).

sections.title: Stationary points
content: Set dy/dx = 0 and solve. Use the second derivative: d²y/dx² > 0 → minimum, < 0 → maximum.

sections.title: Tangents and normals
content: Gradient of tangent = dy/dx at that point; gradient of normal = −1/(dy/dx).

examTips: Double-check whether the question wants the tangent or the normal — mixing these up is one of the most common errors.
